document.name: NY Kids Club Brooklyn Heights Classes
document.shortDescription: Weekday enrichment classes in Brooklyn Heights for babies, toddlers, and young kids, including music, art, science, math, and gym.
document.longDescription:
NY Kids Club Brooklyn Heights publishes a Summer 2025 enrichment schedule for babies, toddlers, and young children at its Brooklyn Heights location. The official PDF lists baby classes for ages 6 to 18 months, toddler classes for ages 18 to 36 months, and older child classes including art, music, science, math, gym, and school-prep style offerings for children up to age 8.

The official schedule shows weekday classes starting with morning baby and toddler sessions at 8:45 AM and continuing through afternoon and after-school options, including Toddler Gym Ninjas at 4:00 PM. The same official PDF footer lists the Brooklyn Heights location at 182 Henry St with phone 718.228.0800 and email bheights@nykidsclub.com.

This listing maps the program to the canonical Brooklyn Heights neighborhood and uses the official NY Kids Club schedule as the source of truth for ages and weekday timing coverage.

Sources: https://nypreschoolandkidsclub.com/brooklyn-heights/ https://nypreschoolandkidsclub.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Brooklyn-Heights-Summer-2025-Class-Schedule.pdf https://dev.nykidsclub.com/wp-content/themes/nykids/images/nykidsclub_logo.jpg
